meta.title: The perfect 4 days itinerary in Da Nang, Vietnam 🇻🇳 + Day Trip to Hoi An
meta.description:
Come along as I spend 4 relaxing days exploring the beautiful city of Da Nang, Vietnam! This trip is all about slowing down, enjoying the scenery, trying delicious local food and taking in the laid-back coastal vibes.

One of the highlights of the trip is a day visit to the charming ancient town of Hoi An, where colourful lanterns, riverside cafés and historic streets create an unforgettable atmosphere.

Whether you're planning your own Vietnam adventure or just looking for a calming travel vlog to unwind with, I hope you enjoy coming along for the journey.

If you enjoyed the video, don't forget to Like 👍, Comment 💬, and Subscribe 🔔 for more travel adventures!
